t.When Allah's command came, Allah saved S: Lokacin da umarnin Allah ya zo, Allah ya ceci Shu'aibu da waɗanda suka yi imani tare da shi, da rahamarsa.
t.When Musa went to meet his Lord for fort: Lokacin da Musa ya tafi ganawa da Ubangijinsa na dare arba'in, ya roƙi Haruna ya maye gurbinsa a cikin mutanensa kuma ya kiyaye gyara. Lokacin da wasu daga cikin mutanen suka ɓata, Haruna ya ce musu: Ubangijinku Mai rahama ne, don haka ku bi ni kuma ku bi maganata.
t.When he arrived in Madinah, he ordered a: Lokacin da ya isa Madina, ya umarta a gina masallaci. Masu filin suka ce: ba mu son kuɗinsa sai daga Allah.
t.When he travelled from Makkah, he hid in: Lokacin da ya yi tafiya daga Makka, ya ɓoye a cikin kogo tare da abokinsa, ya ce masa: Kada ka yi baƙin ciki, Allah yana tare da mu.
t.When he was forty, the first revelation: Lokacin da yake da shekaru arba'in, wahayi na farko ya zo masa a Kogon Hira. Mala'ikan ya ce: Iqra' (Karanta)!
t.When it rains, we ask Allah to make the: Idan ana ruwan sama, muna roƙon Allah ya sanya ruwan ya zama alheri a gare mu.
t.When one of you sneezes, let him say: Al: Idan ɗayanku ya yi atishawa, ya ce: Alhamdulillah (dukkan godiya ta tabbata ga Allah).
t.When someone helps us, we thank them wit: Idan wani ya taimake mu, muna gode masa da wannan addu'a.
t.When the Prophet ﷺ came to Madinah, he o: Lokacin da Annabi ﷺ ya zo Madina, ya umarta a gina masallaci.
t.When the flood came, Nuh carried the bel: Lokacin da ambaliya ta zo, Nuhu ya ɗauki muminai da nau'i-nau'i na dabbobi a cikin jirgin, kuma ya tafi a kan raƙuman ruwa kamar duwatsu.
t.When they were afraid, what did Allah te: Lokacin da suka ji tsoro, me Allah ya ce musu?
t.When things are hard, be patient and cal: Idan abubuwa sun yi wuya, ka yi haƙuri kuma ka kira Allah.
t.When we come home, we say Bismillah and: Idan muka dawo gida, muna cewa Bismillah kuma muna yi wa iyalinmu sallama.
t.When we come out of the bathroom, we ask: Idan muka fito daga bayan gida, muna roƙon Allah ya gafarta mana.
t.When we enter the masjid, we ask Allah f: Idan muka shiga masallaci, muna roƙon Allah rahamarsa.
t.When we feel angry, we say this and calm: Idan muka ji fushi, muna faɗin wannan kuma mu natsu.
t.When we go out, we trust Allah to look a: Idan za mu fita, muna dogara ga Allah ya kula da mu.
t.When we leave the masjid, we ask Allah f: Idan muka fita daga masallaci, muna roƙon Allah falalarsa.
t.When we make a mistake, we say sorry to: Idan muka yi kuskure, muna neman gafarar Allah kuma muna roƙonsa ya yafe mana.
t.When we ride in a car or travel, we say: Idan muka hau mota ko muka yi tafiya, muna faɗin wannan addu'a daga Alƙur'ani.
Idan muka yi atishawa, muna cewa Alhamdulillah.
t.When we wake up, we thank Allah for a ne: Idan muka farka, muna gode wa Allah saboda sabuwar rana.
t.When you enter the mosque, say: O Allah,: Idan ka shiga masallaci, ka ce: Ya Allah, ka buɗe mini ƙofofin rahamarka. Idan ka fita, ka ce: Ya Allah, ina roƙonka daga falalarka.
t.When you sneeze, say Alhamdulillah. The: Idan ka yi atishawa, ka ce Alhamdulillah. Wanda ya ji ka zai ce Yarhamukallah, kai kuma ka amsa: Yahdikumullahu wa yuslihu balakum.
t.Where did Musa's mother place him?: Ina mahaifiyar Musa ta saka shi?
t.Where did the first revelation come to t: A ina wahayi na farko ya zo wa Annabi ﷺ?
t.Which bird brought news to Sulayman?: Wane tsuntsu ne ya kawo wa Sulaimanu labari?
t.Which book did Allah give Dawud?: Wane littafi Allah ya ba Dawuda?
t.Which dua asks Allah for more knowledge?: Wace addu'a ce ke roƙon Allah ƙarin ilimi?
t.Which hand do we eat with?: Da wane hannu muke cin abinci?
t.Which hill did the Prophet ﷺ climb to ca: Wane tudu Annabi ﷺ ya hau don ya kira mutanen Ƙuraishawa?
t.Which name of Allah means the Creator?: Wane sunan Allah ne yake nufin Mahalicci?
t.Which name of Allah means the Provider?: Wane sunan Allah ne yake nufin Mai azurtawa?
t.Which names mean the First and the Last?: Waɗanne sunaye ne suke nufin na Farko da na Ƙarshe?
t.Which of these is NOT one of the four sa: Wanne daga cikin waɗannan BA ya cikin watanni huɗu masu alfarma?
t.Which part do we wash last in wudu?: Wane ɓangare muke wankewa a ƙarshe a alwala?
t.Which prophet built the ship (the ark)?: Wane annabi ne ya gina jirgin ruwa?
t.Which prophet struck the sea with his st: Wane annabi ne ya bugi teku da sandarsa?
t.Which prophet was swallowed by a big fis: Wane annabi ne babban kifi ya haɗiye?
t.Which small creature warned the others i: Wace ƙaramar halitta ce ta gargaɗi sauran a wannan labari?
t.Which surah comes first in the Quran?: Wace sura ce ta farko a Alƙur'ani?
t.Which surah comes last in the Quran?: Wace sura ce ta ƙarshe a Alƙur'ani?
t.Which surah do we recite in every rak'ah: Wace sura muke karantawa a kowace raka'a?
t.Which surah ends with many names of Alla: Wace sura ce take ƙarewa da sunayen Allah masu yawa: Al-Malik, Al-Quddus, As-Salam...?
t.Which two names come together at the sta: Waɗanne sunaye biyu ne suka zo tare a farkon Ayatul Kursiyyu?
t.Which way do we face when we pray?: Wane wuri muke fuskanta lokacin da muke sallah?
t.While he was standing in prayer, the goo: Yana tsaye yana sallah, sai albishir ya zo: Allah zai ba shi ɗa mai suna Yahaya, sunan da Allah bai taɓa ba wa kowa ba a da.
t.Who built the House (Kaaba) with Ibrahim: Wane ne ya gina Ɗakin (Ka'aba) tare da Ibrahim?
t.Who comforted the Prophet ﷺ after the fi: Wane ne ya kwantar wa Annabi ﷺ da hankali bayan wahayi na farko?
t.Who is truly strong?: Wane ne mai ƙarfi na gaskiya?
t.Who most deserves our good company?: Wane ne ya fi cancantar kyakkyawar mu'amalarmu?
t.Who raised the foundations of the Kaaba?: Wane ne ya ɗaga harsashin Ka'aba?
t.Who saw eleven stars, the sun and the mo: Wane ne ya ga taurari goma sha ɗaya, rana da wata a mafarki?
t.Who should say salam first?: Wane ne ya kamata ya fara sallama?
t.Whoever believes in Allah and the Last D: Duk wanda ya yi imani da Allah da Ranar Ƙarshe, ya faɗi alheri ko ya yi shiru.
t.Whoever is not merciful will not be show: Duk wanda ba ya jin ƙai, ba za a ji ƙansa ba.
t.Whom did Musa ask Allah to make his help: Wane ne Musa ya roƙi Allah ya sanya shi mataimakinsa?
t.Whom did Zakariya take care of?: Wane ne Zakariyya ya kula da ita?
Ka shafi kanka da hannaye masu ruwa.
t.Years later he returned and entered Makk: Bayan shekaru ya dawo ya shiga Makka a ranar Buɗe Makka (Al-Fath). Taimakon Allah da nasara sun zo.
Eh, an gina Musulunci a kan biyar.
Eh, kalma mai daɗi sadaka ce.
t.Yes, even his people knew he was truthfu: Eh, har mutanensa sun san shi mai gaskiya ne.
Eh, ya umarta a gina masallacin.
Eh, don haka muna raba abincinmu.
Eh, Annabi ﷺ ya faɗi haka.
t.Yes. Being kind to animals brings reward: Eh. Tausaya wa dabbobi yana kawo lada.
t.Yes. He forgives those who turn back to: Eh. Yana gafarta wa waɗanda suka koma gare Shi.
t.Yes: Say Bismillah and eat with your rig: Eh: Ka ce Bismillah kuma ka ci da hannun damanka.
Eh: Ka ce, Shi ne Allah, Ɗaya.
t.Young Yusuf saw a dream: eleven stars, t: Yusuf yana ƙarami ya yi mafarki: taurari goma sha ɗaya, rana da wata suna yi masa sujada. Ya gaya wa mahaifinsa Yakubu.
t.Your friend sneezes and says Alhamdulill: Abokinka ya yi atishawa ya ce Alhamdulillah. Me za ka ce?
t.Yunus left his people and boarded a ship: Yunusa ya bar mutanensa ya hau wani jirgin ruwa da ya cika maƙil.
t.Yunus was brought out onto the shore, an: An fitar da Yunusa zuwa bakin teku, kuma Allah ya tsirar masa da wata shuka a kansa.
Yusuf ne ya ga wannan mafarki.
t.Zakariya had grown old and his wife had: Zakariyya ya tsufa kuma matarsa ba ta haihuwa. Ya kira Ubangijinsa a ɓoye: Ya Ubangijina, ka ba ni zuriya ta gari daga gare ka. Kai mai jin kowace addu'a ne.
t.Zakariya took care of Maryam. Whenever h: Zakariyya ya kula da Maryamu. Duk lokacin da ya shiga ɗakin ibadarta, yakan sami abinci a wurinta. Ya tambaye ta: Daga ina wannan ya fito? Ta ce: Daga Allah ne. Allah yana azurta wanda ya so ba tare da lissafi ba.
t.Zakariya wondered how this could be, and: Zakariyya ya yi mamakin yadda hakan zai yiwu, sai Allah ya ce: Abu ne mai sauƙi a gare Ni. A matsayin alama, Zakariyya bai yi magana da mutane ba dare uku sai da ishara, kuma ya ce musu su yi tasbihi ga Allah safe da yamma.
